questions.question: 78912. What problem may occur when the platelet count decreases?
questions.explain:
• প্লেটলেটের সংখ্যা কমে গেলে রক্ত জমাট বাঁধার ক্ষমতা কমে যায়, ফলে Increased risk of bleeding দেখা দিতে পারে।

• প্লেটলেটের ভূমিকা:
- রক্তনালি ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হলে প্লেটলেট একত্রিত হয়ে ক্ষতস্থানে একটি প্লাগ তৈরি করে এবং রক্তপাত বন্ধ করতে সাহায্য করে।
- প্লেটলেটের সংখ্যা স্বাভাবিকের চেয়ে কমে গেলে এই জমাট বাঁধার প্রক্রিয়া ব্যাহত হয়। এই অবস্থাকে থ্রম্বোসাইটোপেনিয়া বলা হয়।
- সামান্য আঘাতের পরও দীর্ঘসময় রক্তপাত, ত্বকে পিটিকিয়া বা পুরপুরা, নাক ও মাড়ি দিয়ে রক্তপাত, প্রস্রাব বা পায়খানায় রক্ত এবং অতিরিক্ত মাসিক রক্তপাত হতে পারে।

উৎস:
১) National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI), “Thrombocytopenia”.

questions.question: 78911. Why are iron and folic acid given to pregnant women during pregnancy?
questions.explain:
• গর্ভাবস্থায় আয়রন ও ফলিক অ্যাসিড দেওয়া হয় মাতৃ-অ্যানিমিয়া প্রতিরোধের জন্য।

• আয়রন ও ফলিক অ্যাসিডের প্রয়োজনীয়তা:
- আয়রনের ঘাটতি হলে হিমোগ্লোবিনের উৎপাদন কমে আয়রন-ঘাটতিজনিত অ্যানিমিয়া হতে পারে।
- ফলিক অ্যাসিড রক্তকণিকা তৈরি ও ভ্রূণের স্বাভাবিক বিকাশে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখে।
- WHO-এর তথ্য অনুযায়ী, গর্ভাবস্থায় আয়রন ও ফলিক অ্যাসিড গ্রহণ করলে আয়রনের ঘাটতি ও অ্যানিমিয়ার ঝুঁকি কমে।

উৎস:
১) World Health Organization (WHO), “Daily iron and folic acid supplementation during pregnancy”.

questions.question: 78910. What is the appropriate position for a patient during insertion of an NG tube?
questions.explain:
• NG টিউব প্রবেশের সময় রোগীকে Fowler's position, অর্থাৎ মাথা ও বুক উঁচু করে বসানো অবস্থায় রাখা উপযুক্ত।

• Fowler's position এর গুরুত্ব:
- এই অবস্থানে রোগীর মাথা ও বুক সাধারণত কমপক্ষে ৩০ ডিগ্রি উঁচু থাকে।
- রোগী সোজা হয়ে থাকায় নাক, গলবিল ও খাদ্যনালির পথে টিউব অগ্রসর করা তুলনামূলক সহজ হয়।
- রোগীকে গিলতে এবং নির্দেশনা অনুসরণ করতে সুবিধা হয়।
- টিউব শ্বাসনালিতে চলে যাওয়ার ঝুঁকি কমাতে সঠিক অবস্থান ও কৌশল অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
- টিউব প্রবেশের পর এর অবস্থান নিশ্চিত না হওয়া পর্যন্ত টিউবের মাধ্যমে খাবার, পানি বা ওষুধ দেওয়া উচিত নয়।

উৎস:
১) NCBI Bookshelf, “Nursing Advanced Skills: Insert Nasogastric and Feeding Tubes”.
২) Merck Manual Professional Edition, “How to Insert a Nasogastric Tube”.

questions.question: 78909. What is the first part of the small intestine?
questions.explain:
• ক্ষুদ্রান্ত্রের প্রথম অংশ হলো ডুডেনাম।

• ডুডেনামের অবস্থান ও কাজ:
- ক্ষুদ্রান্ত্র তিনটি অংশ নিয়ে গঠিত—ডুডেনাম, জেজুনাম ও ইলিয়াম।
- পাকস্থলীর পাইলোরাসের পরেই ডুডেনাম শুরু হয় এবং এরপর জেজুনাম অবস্থিত।
- ডুডেনাম ক্ষুদ্রান্ত্রের প্রথম, তুলনামূলক ছোট ও প্রশস্ত অংশ।
- যকৃত ও পিত্তথলি থেকে পিত্তরস এবং অগ্ন্যাশয় থেকে হজমকারী এনজাইম ডুডেনামে প্রবেশ করে।
- এখানে পাকস্থলী থেকে আসা অর্ধপরিপাক খাদ্য পিত্তরস ও অগ্ন্যাশয়ের এনজাইমের সঙ্গে মিশে পরবর্তী হজম ও শোষণের জন্য প্রস্তুত হয়।

অন্যান্য অপশন:
→ Cecum: এটি বৃহদান্ত্রের শুরুতে অবস্থিত।
→ Jejunum: এটি ডুডেনামের পরবর্তী, অর্থাৎ ক্ষুদ্রান্ত্রের দ্বিতীয় অংশ।
→ Ileum: এটি ক্ষুদ্রান্ত্রের শেষ অংশ এবং বৃহদান্ত্রের সিকামের সঙ্গে যুক্ত হয়।

উৎস:
১) MSD Manual, “Small Intestine”.
২) NCBI Bookshelf, “The Digestive System”.

questions.question: 78908. Approximately what percentage of plasma is water?
questions.explain:
• রক্তরস বা প্লাজমার প্রায় ৯০–৯২% হলো পানি।

• প্লাজমার গঠন:
- প্লাজমা হলো রক্তের তরল অংশ, যেখানে রক্তকণিকাগুলো ভাসমান থাকে।
- প্লাজমার প্রায় ৯০–৯২% পানি এবং প্রায় ৬–৮% প্রোটিন থাকে।
- এতে অ্যালবুমিন, গ্লোবিউলিন, ফাইব্রিনোজেন, ইলেকট্রোলাইট, পুষ্টি উপাদান, হরমোন, দ্রবীভূত গ্যাস ও বিপাকীয় বর্জ্য থাকে।
- প্লাজমা পুষ্টি উপাদান, হরমোন, শ্বাসীয় গ্যাস ও বর্জ্য পদার্থ পরিবহন করে।
- এটি দেহের তরল ভারসাম্য, অম্ল-ক্ষার ভারসাম্য ও অসমোটিক চাপ বজায় রাখতে সাহায্য করে। তাই সঠিক উত্তর হলো ৯০–৯২%।

উৎস:
১) NCBI Bookshelf—StatPearls, “Physiology, Blood Plasma”.

questions.question: 78907. Which vaccine is given to prevent tuberculosis?
questions.explain:
• যক্ষ্মা প্রতিরোধে ব্যবহৃত টিকা হলো BCG, যার পূর্ণরূপ ব্যাসিলাস ক্যালমেট–গেরিন।

• BCG টিকা:
- BCG হলো যক্ষ্মা বা টিউবারকিউলোসিস প্রতিরোধের টিকা।
- WHO অনুযায়ী, যেসব দেশে যক্ষ্মার প্রকোপ বেশি, সেখানে শিশুদের BCG টিকা দেওয়া হয়।
- এই টিকা শিশুদের গুরুতর ধরনের যক্ষ্মা, বিশেষ করে যক্ষ্মাজনিত মেনিনজাইটিস ও মিলিয়ারি টিউবারকিউলোসিস থেকে সুরক্ষা দিতে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ভূমিকা রাখে।
- BCG টিকার সুরক্ষা শিশুদের গুরুতর যক্ষ্মার ক্ষেত্রে বেশি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ; প্রাপ্তবয়স্কদের ফুসফুসের যক্ষ্মা প্রতিরোধে এর কার্যকারিতা বিভিন্ন অঞ্চলে ভিন্ন হতে পারে।

অন্যান্য অপশন:
→ DPT: ডিফথেরিয়া, পারটুসিস ও টিটেনাস প্রতিরোধে ব্যবহৃত হয়।
→ Hepatitis B: হেপাটাইটিস বি ভাইরাসের সংক্রমণ প্রতিরোধ করে।
→ OPV: পোলিওমায়েলাইটিস বা পোলিও রোগ প্রতিরোধে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

উৎস:
১) World Health Organization (WHO), “Tuberculosis”.
২) Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), “BCG Vaccine for Tuberculosis”.

questions.question: 78906. What is the largest part of the human brain?
questions.explain:
• মানব মস্তিষ্কের বৃহত্তম অংশ হলো সেরিব্রাম বা বৃহৎ মস্তিষ্ক।

• সেরিব্রামের গঠন ও কাজ:
- মানব মস্তিষ্কের তিনটি প্রধান অংশ হলো সেরিব্রাম, সেরিবেলাম এবং ব্রেনস্টেম।
- সেরিব্রাম ডান ও বাম—দুটি সেরিব্রাল হেমিস্ফিয়ারে বিভক্ত। দুটি হেমিস্ফিয়ার করপাস ক্যালোসামের মাধ্যমে যুক্ত থাকে।
- এর বাইরের স্তরকে সেরিব্রাল কর্টেক্স বলা হয়, যা গ্রে ম্যাটার দিয়ে গঠিত; ভেতরের অংশে প্রধানত হোয়াইট ম্যাটার থাকে।
- সেরিব্রাম ইচ্ছাধীন নড়াচড়া, সংবেদন, চিন্তা, বুদ্ধি, স্মৃতি, ভাষা, অনুভূতি এবং সচেতন আচরণ নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে।
- সেরিব্রামের প্রধান চারটি লোব হলো ফ্রন্টাল, প্যারাইটাল, টেম্পোরাল ও অক্সিপিটাল লোব।

অন্যান্য অপশন:
→ পনস: এটি ব্রেনস্টেমের একটি অংশ এবং বিভিন্ন স্নায়ুপথের সংযোগে ভূমিকা রাখে।
→ মেডুলা: ব্রেনস্টেমের নিম্নাংশ; শ্বাস-প্রশ্বাস, হৃদস্পন্দন ও রক্তচাপের মতো স্বয়ংক্রিয় কাজ নিয়ন্ত্রণে সহায়তা করে।
→ সেরিবেলাম: শরীরের ভারসাম্য, অঙ্গসঞ্চালনের সমন্বয় ও অঙ্গবিন্যাস নিয়ন্ত্রণ করে; এটি সেরিব্রামের চেয়ে ছোট।

উৎস:
১) NCBI Bookshelf—StatPearls, “Physiology, Brain”.
২) MSD Manual, “Brain”.

questions.question: 78905. What is the most important complication of diarrhea?
questions.explain:
• ডায়রিয়ার সবচেয়ে গুরুত্বপূর্ণ জটিলতা হলো পানিশূন্যতা, কারণ বারবার তরল পায়খানার মাধ্যমে শরীর থেকে পানি ও প্রয়োজনীয় লবণ বের হয়ে যায়।

• ডায়রিয়ায় পানিশূন্যতা:
- তরল পায়খানার সঙ্গে সোডিয়াম, ক্লোরাইড, পটাশিয়াম ও বাইকার্বোনেটের মতো ইলেকট্রোলাইটের ক্ষতি হয়।
- বমি থাকলে পানি ও ইলেকট্রোলাইটের ক্ষতি আরও বেড়ে যায়।
- হারানো পানি ও লবণ প্রতিস্থাপন না করলে তৃষ্ণা, মুখ শুষ্ক হওয়া, প্রস্রাব কমে যাওয়া এবং দুর্বলতা দেখা দিতে পারে।
- গুরুতর পানিশূন্যতা শক সৃষ্টি করতে পারে এবং জীবনহানির কারণ হতে পারে।
- WHO-এর মতে, ডায়রিয়ার সবচেয়ে গুরুতর হুমকি হলো পানিশূন্যতা। তাই চিকিৎসার গুরুত্বপূর্ণ অংশ হলো ORS; গুরুতর পানিশূন্যতা বা শকে IV তরল প্রয়োজন হতে পারে।

উৎস:
১) World Health Organization (WHO), “Diarrhoea”.
২) NHS, “Diarrhoea and vomiting”.

questions.question: 78904. What is meant by hypoglycemia?
questions.explain:
• Hypoglycemia বলতে রক্তে স্বাভাবিকের তুলনায় কম glucose-এর উপস্থিতিকে বোঝায়।

• Hypoglycemia:
- Diabetes-এ ব্যবহৃত বর্তমান শ্রেণিবিন্যাসে রক্তের glucose 70 mg/dL-এর নিচে নামলে clinically important hypoglycemia হিসেবে বিবেচনা করা হয়।

• রক্তের glucose মাত্রা:
- রক্তের glucose শরীরের কোষ, বিশেষত মস্তিষ্কের জন্য গুরুত্বপূর্ণ শক্তির উৎস।
- Glucose মাত্রা অতিরিক্ত কমে গেলে autonomic ও neuroglycopenic লক্ষণ দেখা দিতে পারে।
- Level 1 hypoglycemia হলো glucose 70 mg/dL কিন্তু ≥ 54 mg/dL।
- Level 2 hypoglycemia হলো glucose 54 mg/dL-এর নিচে।

• Hypoglycemia-এর সাধারণ প্রকাশ:
- কাঁপুনি, ঘাম, ক্ষুধা, বিরক্তি, tachycardia ও দুর্বলতা দেখা দিতে পারে।
- আরও কম glucose মাত্রায় confusion এবং অন্যান্য neuroglycopenic লক্ষণ দেখা দিতে পারে।

অন্যান্য অপশন:
→ Decreased sodium level: রক্তে sodium-এর মাত্রা কমে যাওয়াকে hyponatremia বলা হয়।
→ Decreased blood pressure: রক্তচাপ কমে যাওয়াকে hypotension বলা হয়।
→ Increased blood glucose level: রক্তে glucose-এর মাত্রা বেড়ে যাওয়াকে hyperglycemia বলা হয়।

উৎস:
১) NCBI MedGen, Hypoglycemia (Concept Id: C0020615), Definition section
২) NCBI Bookshelf, Endotext, Hypoglycemia During Therapy of Diabetes, Definition and Classification of Hypoglycemia section

questions.question: 78903. Which microorganism is responsible for tetanus?
questions.explain:
• Clostridium tetani হলো টিটেনাসের জন্য দায়ী স্পোর-গঠনকারী ব্যাকটেরিয়া।

• টিটেনাস:

- টিটেনাস একটি গুরুতর, টিকা-প্রতিরোধযোগ্য রোগ। - রোগটি Clostridium tetani নামের স্পোর-গঠনকারী ব্যাকটেরিয়ার টক্সিনের কারণে হয়। - ব্যাকটেরিয়ার স্পোর পরিবেশে, বিশেষত মাটি, ধুলা এবং প্রাণীর মলে পাওয়া যেতে পারে। - ত্বকের ক্ষত বা ক্ষতস্থানের মাধ্যমে স্পোর শরীরে প্রবেশ করতে পারে এবং কম-অক্সিজেন পরিবেশে অঙ্কুরিত হয়ে টক্সিন উৎপন্ন করতে পারে।

• টিটেনাস টক্সিন:

- C. tetani থেকে উৎপন্ন প্রধান টক্সিন হলো tetanospasmin। - এই টক্সিন স্নায়ুতন্ত্রে প্রভাব ফেলে এবং পেশির শক্ত হয়ে যাওয়া ও খিঁচুনিজনিত সংকোচনের সঙ্গে টিটেনাসের বৈশিষ্ট্যপূর্ণ লক্ষণ সৃষ্টি করে।

• প্রধান ক্লিনিক্যাল বৈশিষ্ট্য:

- টিটেনাসে সাধারণত চোয়াল ও ঘাড়ের পেশিতে শক্তভাব ও সংকোচন দেখা দিতে পারে। - চোয়ালের পেশি শক্ত হয়ে মুখ খুলতে অসুবিধা হওয়াকে lockjaw বা trismus বলা হয়। - সাধারণীকৃত টিটেনাসে শরীরের বিভিন্ন পেশিতে শক্তভাব ও খিঁচুনিজনিত সংকোচন দেখা দিতে পারে।

• সংক্রমণ ও সংক্রমণ-প্রক্রিয়া:

- টিটেনাস সাধারণত ব্যক্তি থেকে ব্যক্তিতে সংক্রমিত হয় না। - স্পোর ক্ষতস্থানে প্রবেশের পর উপযুক্ত পরিবেশে অঙ্কুরিত হয়ে টক্সিন উৎপন্ন করে।

অন্যান্য অপশন:

→ Salmonella: Salmonella-র বিভিন্ন প্রজাতি প্রধানত অন্ত্রের সংক্রমণ ও খাদ্যবাহিত রোগের সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত।
→ Mycobacterium: এই গণের বিভিন্ন প্রজাতি যক্ষ্মা ও অন্যান্য মাইকোব্যাকটেরিয়াল সংক্রমণের সঙ্গে সম্পর্কিত।
→ Staphylococcus: এই গণের ব্যাকটেরিয়া বিভিন্ন সংক্রমণ ঘটাতে পারে।

উৎস:
১) Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Manual for the Surveillance of Vaccine-Preventable Diseases, Chapter 16: Tetanus.
২) Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), Tetanus Surveillance — United States, 2009–2023, MMWR Surveillance Summaries, Vol. 75, No. 1, 2026.

questions.question: 78902. If 3sinθ + 4cosθ = 5, where 0° < θ < 90°, what is the value of tanθ?
questions.explain:
Question: If 3sinθ + 4cosθ = 5, where 0° < θ < 90°, what is the value of tanθ?

Solution:
Given,
3sinθ + 4cosθ = 5
⇒ 3(sinθ/cosθ) + 4 = 5/cosθ [ Dividing both sides by cosθ ]
⇒ 3tanθ + 4 = 5secθ
⇒ (3tanθ + 4)2 = (5secθ)2  [ Squaring both sides ] 
⇒ 9tan2θ + 24tanθ + 16 = 25sec2θ
⇒ 9tan2θ + 24tanθ + 16 = 25(1 + tan2θ) [  sec2θ = 1 + tan2θ ]
⇒ 9tan2θ + 24tanθ + 16 = 25 + 25tan2θ 
⇒ 25tan2θ - 9tan2θ - 24tanθ + 25 - 16 = 0 
⇒ 16tan2θ - 24tanθ + 9 = 0 
⇒ (4tanθ - 3)2 = 0
⇒ 4tanθ - 3 = 0
⇒ 4tanθ = 3
∴ tanθ = 3/4

So, the value of tanθ = 3/4

questions.question: 78901. If (a + b) : (b + c) : (c + a) = 3 : 4 : 5 and a + b + c = 24, what is the value of c?
questions.explain:
Question: If (a + b) : (b + c) : (c + a) = 3 : 4 : 5 and a + b + c = 24, what is the value of c?

Solution:
Let,
a + b = 3k
b + c = 4k
c + a = 5k

Now,
(a + b) + (b + c) + (c + a) = 3k + 4k + 5k
⇒ 2(a + b + c) = 12k
⇒ a + b + c = 12k/2 
⇒ a + b + c = 6k

Given,
a + b + c = 24

ATQ,
⇒ 6k = 24
⇒ k = 24/6
∴ k = 4

The value of a + b = 3k
= 3 × 4
= 12

Now, the value of c = (a + b + c) - (a + b)
= 24 - 12
= 12

So, the value of c = 12

questions.question: 78900. In an arithmetic progression, the 4th term is 14 and the sum of the first 8 terms is 136. What is the 15th term of this progression?
questions.explain:
Question: In an arithmetic progression, the 4th term is 14 and the sum of the first 8 terms is 136. What is the 15th term of this progression?

Solution:
Let,
First term of the arithmetic progression = a
Common difference = d

nth term Tn = a + (n - 1)d
The sum of first n terms Sn = (n/2) × [2a + (n - 1)d]

For the 4th term: T4 = a + (4 - 1)d
⇒ a + 3d = 14 ----- (1)

For the sum of the first 8 terms: S8 = (8/2) × [2a + (8 - 1)d]
⇒ 4 × [2a + 7d] = 136
⇒ 2a + 7d = 136/4 
⇒ 2a + 7d = 34 ----- (2)

From Equation 1,
a = 14 - 3d
Substituting the value of 'a' in Equation 2
⇒ 2 × (14 - 3d) + 7d = 34 
⇒ 28 - 6d + 7d = 34
⇒ 28 + d = 34
⇒ d = 34 - 28
∴ d = 6

Now, the value of 'a'
⇒ a = 14 - (3 × 6) 
⇒ a = 14 - 18
∴ a = - 4

Now, the 15th term (T15) = a + (15 - 1)d
= a + 14d
= - 4 + 14(6)
= - 4 + 84
= 80

So, the 15th term of this progression = 80

questions.question: 78899. A 20-liter tank used for crop spraying is full of a fertilizer solution containing 35% concentrate. How many liters of this solution must be drawn off and replaced with pure water so that the resulting solution contains only 14% concentrate?
questions.explain:
Question: A 20-liter tank used for crop spraying is full of a fertilizer solution containing 35% concentrate. How many liters of this solution must be drawn off and replaced with pure water so that the resulting solution contains only 14% concentrate?

Solution:
Let,
Amount of solution drawn off and replaced with pure water = x liters
Total volume of the tank = 20 liters
Remaining volume of solution before adding water = (20 - x) liters

Amount of concentrate in the remaining solution = 35% of (20 - x)
= (35/100) × (20 - x) 
= 0.35(20 - x)

Final amount of concentrate needed in 20 liters of 14% solution = 14% of 20
= (14/100) × 20
= 2.8 liters

ATQ,
⇒ 0.35 × (20 - x) = 2.8 
⇒ 20 - x = 2.8/0.35
⇒ 20 - x = 280/35 
⇒ 20 - x = 8
⇒ x = 20 - 8
∴ x = 12

So, 12 liters of the solution must be drawn off and replaced with pure water.

questions.question: 78898. How many integer values of x satisfy the inequality |2x - 3| ≤ 7?
questions.explain:
Question: How many integer values of x satisfy the inequality |2x - 3| ≤ 7?

Solution:
Given inequality:
|2x - 3| ≤ 7
⇒ - 7 ≤ (2x - 3) ≤ 7    [If |u| ≤ a, then -a ≤ u ≤ a]
⇒ (- 7 + 3) ≤ 2x ≤ (7 + 3)  [Adding 3 on both sides]
⇒ - 4 ≤ 2x ≤ 10 
⇒ - 4/2 ≤ x ≤ 10/2 [Divided by 2 both sides] 
∴ - 2 ≤ x ≤ 5

Here,
First Number = -2
Last Number = 5

Total Count of integers = (Last Number - First Number) + 1
= 5 - (-2) + 1
= 5 + 2 + 1
= 8
The integer values of x in this range are: -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5

So, the number of integer values of x that satisfy the inequality = 8

questions.question: 78897. The radius of a cylindrical steel drum is decreased by 20% while its height is increased by p%. If the volume of the drum decreases by 20%, what is the value of p?
questions.explain:
Question: The radius of a cylindrical steel drum is decreased by 20% while its height is increased by p%. If the volume of the drum decreases by 20%, what is the value of p?

Solution:
Let,
Initial radius = r
Initial height = h
Initial volume V = πr2h

New radius = r - (20% of r)
= 0.8r
New height = h + (p% of h)
= h(1 + p/100)

New volume = π(0.8r)2 × h {1 + (p/100)}
= 0.64πr2h {1 + (p/100)}
= 0.64V {1 + (p/100)}

Since, the volume decreases by 20%:
New volume = V - (20% of V)
= 0.8V

ATQ,
⇒ 0.64V × {1 + (p/100)} = 0.8V 
⇒ 0.64 × {1 + (p/100)} = 0.8 
⇒ 1 + (p/100) = 0.8/0.64
⇒ 1 + (p/100) = 80/64 
⇒ 1 + (p/100) = 5/4
⇒ 1 + (p/100) = 1.25
⇒ p/100 = 1.25 - 1
⇒ p/100 = 0.25
⇒ p = 0.25 × 100
∴ p = 25

So, the value of p = 25

questions.question: 78896. Three investors put money into a textile business in the ratio 5 : 6 : 9. Out of the total profit, 15% is deducted for taxes and 5% is set aside for employee bonuses. The remainder is split according to their investment ratio. If the second investor's share is Tk. 24,000, what is the total profit?
questions.explain:
Question: Three investors put money into a textile business in the ratio 5 : 6 : 9. Out of the total profit, 15% is deducted for taxes and 5% is set aside for employee bonuses. The remainder is split according to their investment ratio. If the second investor's share is Tk. 24,000, what is the total profit?

Solution:
Let,
Total profit = x
Ratio of investments = 5 : 6 : 9
Sum of the ratio terms = 5 + 6 + 9 = 20

Total deductions = 15% (tax) + 5% (bonus)
= 20% Remaining profit to be distributed
= x - (20% of x)
= x - (20x/100) 
= x - (x/5) 
= 4x/5

Share of the second investor = (6/20) × (4x/5)
= (3/10) × (4x/5)
= 12x/50
= 6x/25

ATQ,
⇒ 6x/25 = 24000
⇒ 6x = (24000 × 25)
⇒ 6x = 600000
⇒ x = 600000/6
∴ x = 100000

So, the total profit = Tk. 1,00,000

questions.question: 78895. Find the remainder obtained when the sum (5<sup>37</sup> + 6<sup>37</sup> + 7<sup>37</sup> + 8<sup>37</sup>) is divided by 13.
questions.explain:
Question: Find the remainder obtained when the sum (537 + 637 + 737 + 837) is divided by 13.

Solution:
We know, 
When n is an odd positive integer, (an + bn) is always completely divisible by (a + b).

Given,
Sum = (537 + 637 + 737 + 837)
= (537 + 837) + (637 + 737)

Here, the power (37) is an odd integer.

For the first pair (537 + 837)
Since 37 is odd,
(537 + 837) is divisible by (5 + 8) = 13 
⇒ Remainder of (537 + 837) when divided by 13 = 0

For the second pair (637 + 737)
Since 37 is odd,
(637 + 737) is divisible by (6 + 7) = 13 
⇒ Remainder of (637 + 737) when divided by 13 = 0

ATQ,
⇒ Total Remainder = Remainder of 1st pair + Remainder of 2nd pair
⇒ Total Remainder = 0 + 0
∴ Total Remainder = 0

So, the remainder obtained when the sum is divided by 13 = 0

questions.question: 78894. Line L<sub>1 </sub>passes through (a, 2) and (3, 10), and Line L<sub>2</sub> passes through (- 2, 5) and (6, b). If Line L1 is perpendicular to Line L<sub>2</sub> and the slope of L1 is 4, what is the value of a + b?
questions.explain:
Question: Line L1 passes through (a, 2) and (3, 10), and Line L2 passes through (- 2, 5) and (6, b). If Line L1 is perpendicular to Line L2 and the slope of L1 is 4, what is the value of a + b?

Solution:
The slope of a line passing through (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) = (y2 - y1)/(x2 - x1)

For Line L1 passing through (a, 2) and (3, 10):
Slope of L1 (m1) = (10 - 2)/(3 - a) 
= 8/(3 - a)

Given,
Slope of L1 = 4

ATQ,
⇒ 8/(3 - a) = 4
⇒ 4(3 - a) = 8
⇒ 12 - 4a = 8
⇒ 4a = 12 - 8
⇒ 4a = 4
∴ a = 1

For two perpendicular lines, the product of their slopes is -1:
m1 × m2 = - 1 
⇒ 4 × m2 = - 1 
∴ Slope of L2 (m2) = - 1/4

For Line L2 passing through (- 2, 5) and (6, b): 
Slope of L2 (m2) = (b - 5)/(6 - (-2)) 
= (b - 5)/(6 + 2) 
= (b - 5)/8

ATQ,
⇒ (b - 5)/8 = - 1/4 
⇒ 4(b - 5) = - 8 
⇒ b - 5 = - 8/4 
⇒ b - 5 = - 2 
⇒ b = - 2 + 5 
∴ b = 3

Now,
a + b = 1 + 3 = 4

So, the value of a + b = 4

questions.question: 78893. 4 farmers and 6 laborers can harvest a paddy field in 15 days, while 14 farmers and 7 laborers can harvest it in 6 days. How many days will 9 farmers and 12 laborers take to harvest the field?
questions.explain:
Question: 4 farmers and 6 laborers can harvest a paddy field in 15 days, while 14 farmers and 7 laborers can harvest it in 6 days. How many days will 9 farmers and 12 laborers take to harvest the field?

Solution:
Let,
Work done by 1 farmer in 1 day = F
Work done by 1 laborer in 1 day = L

Total work done in 1st case = (4F + 6L) × 15
= 60F + 90L
Total work done in 2nd case = (14F + 7L) × 6
= 84F + 42L

ATQ,
⇒ 60F + 90L = 84F + 42L
⇒ 90L - 42L = 84F - 60F
⇒ 48L = 24F
⇒ 24F = 48L
⇒ F = 48L/24
∴ 1 F = 2 L 

Total Work = (4F + 6L) × 15
= {4 × (2L) + 6L} × 15 
= (8L + 6L) × 15
= 14L × 15
= 210L

Daily work of 9 farmers and 12 laborers:
= 9F + 12L
= {9 × (2L) + 12L}
= 18L + 12L
= 30L

Number of days required = Total Work/Daily Work
= 210L/30L
= 7

So, 9 farmers and 12 laborers will take 7 days to harvest the field.

questions.question: 78892. If log<sub>5</sub>(x) + log<sub>25</sub>(x) + log<sub>125</sub>(x) = 11/6, what is the value of x?
questions.explain:
Question: If log5(x) + log25(x) + log125(x) = 11/6, what is the value of x?

Solution:
We know the base-power rule of logarithm,
log(bn)(x) = (1/n) × log(b)(x)

Therefore,
log25(x) = log52(x)
= (1/2) × log5(x)
log125(x) = log53(x)
= (1/3) × log5(x)

Let,
log5(x) = y

Then,
log25(x) = y/2
log125(x) = y/3

ATQ,
⇒ y + (y/2) + (y/3) = 11/6
⇒ (6y + 3y + 2y)/6 = 11/6 
⇒ 11y / 6 = 11/6
⇒ 11y = 11
∴ y = 1

Since y = log5(x)
⇒ log5(x) = 1
⇒ x = 51
∴ x = 5

So, the value of x = 5

questions.question: 78891. The average of a set of 5 consecutive integers is X. If the next 4 consecutive integers greater than the largest integer of this set are included, by how much does the average increase?
questions.explain:
Question: The average of a set of 5 consecutive integers is X. If the next 4 consecutive integers greater than the largest integer of this set are included, by how much does the average increase?

Solution:
Let,
The 5 consecutive integers = a, a + 1, a + 2, a + 3, a + 4

Sum of the first 5 consecutive integers = a + (a + 1) + (a + 2) + (a + 3) + (a + 4)
= 5a + 10

Original Average (X) = (5a + 10)/5 
= a + 2

The next 4 consecutive integers = a + 5, a + 6, a + 7, a + 8

Total number of integers now = 5 + 4
= 9

Sum of all 9 consecutive integers = (5a + 10) + (a + 5 + a + 6 + a + 7 + a + 8)
= (5a + 10) + (4a + 26)
= 9a + 36

New Average = (9a + 36)/9
= a + 4

ATQ,
⇒ Increase in average = New Average - Original Average
⇒ Increase in average = (a + 4) - (a + 2)
∴ Increase in average = 2

So, the average increases by 2

questions.question: 78890. A square garden is surrounded by a path of uniform width 2.5 meters. If the area of the path alone is 145 square meters, what is the perimeter of the outer boundary of the path?
questions.explain:
Question: A square garden is surrounded by a path of uniform width 2.5 meters. If the area of the path alone is 145 square meters, what is the perimeter of the outer boundary of the path?

Solution:

Let,
Side length of the square garden = x meters
Area of the square garden = x2 sq meters

Width of the path = 2.5 meters
Side length of the outer square = x + 2(2.5)
= x + 5 meters
Area of the outer square = (x + 5)2 sq meters

Area of the path = Area of outer square - Area of inner garden
= (x + 5)2 - x2
= x2 + 10x + 25 - x2
= 10x + 25

ATQ,
⇒ 10x + 25 = 145
⇒ 10x = 145 - 25
⇒ 10x = 120
⇒ x = 120/10
∴ x = 12

Side length of the outer boundary = x + 5
= 12 + 5
= 17 meters

Perimeter of the outer boundary = 4 × 17 = 68 meters

questions.question: 78889. Three pipes A, B, and C can fill an empty reservoir in 12, 15, and 20 hours respectively. If all three pipes are opened together at 6:00 AM, Pipe A is closed at 8:00 AM, and Pipe B is closed at 9:00 AM, at what time will the reservoir be completely filled by Pipe C?
questions.explain:
Question: Three pipes A, B, and C can fill an empty reservoir in 12, 15, and 20 hours respectively. If all three pipes are opened together at 6:00 AM, Pipe A is closed at 8:00 AM, and Pipe B is closed at 9:00 AM, at what time will the reservoir be completely filled by Pipe C?

Solution:
Let,
Total capacity of the reservoir = 1 part

Part filled by Pipe A in 1 hour = 1/12
Part filled by Pipe B in 1 hour = 1/15
Part filled by Pipe C in 1 hour = 1/20

Part filled by (A + B + C) together in 1 hour = 1/12 + 1/15 + 1/20
= (5 + 4 + 3)/60
= 12/60
= 1/5

From 6:00 AM to 8:00 AM (2 hours), all three pipes were open:
Part filled in first 2 hours = 2 × (1/5)
= 2/5
From 8:00 AM to 9:00 AM (1 hour), Pipe A was closed, so only B and C were open:
Part filled by (B + C) in 1 hour = 1/15 + 1/20
= (4 + 3)/60
= 7/60

Total part filled up to 9:00 AM = {(2/5) + (7/60)}
= (24 + 7)/60
= 31/60

Remaining part to be filled = 1 - (31/60)
= 29/60

After 9:00 AM, Pipe B was closed, so only Pipe C was open:
Time required by Pipe C to fill the remaining part = (29/60)/(1/20)
= (29/60) × 20
= 29/3 hours
= 9 hours 40 minutes

ATQ,
Completion time = 9:00 AM + 9 hours 40 minutes
∴ Completion time = 6:40 PM

So, the reservoir will be completely filled at 6:40 PM

questions.question: 78888. Ten years ago, the ratio of the ages of a father and his son was 3 : 1. Ten years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 2 : 1. What is the present age of the son?
questions.explain:
Question: Ten years ago, the ratio of the ages of a father and his son was 3 : 1. Ten years hence, the ratio of their ages will be 2 : 1. What is the present age of the son?

Solution:
Let,
Age of the father ten years ago = 3x
Age of the son ten years ago = x

Present age of father = 3x + 10
Present age of son = x + 10

Age of father ten years hence = (3x + 10) + 10
= 3x + 20
Age of son ten years hence = (x + 10) + 10
= x + 20

ATQ,
⇒ (3x + 20)/(x + 20) = 2/1 
⇒ 1(3x + 20) = 2(x + 20)
⇒ 3x + 20 = 2x + 40
⇒ 3x - 2x = 40 - 20
∴ x = 20

Present age of son = x + 10
= 20 + 10
= 30

So, the present age of the son = 30 years

questions.question: 78887. Ms. Nasrin deposits Tk. 2,50,000 into her retirement savings account on January 1 and another Tk. 2,50,000 on July 1 of the same year. The account earns 12% annual interest compounded semi-annually. Find the total interest earned at year end.
questions.explain:
Question: Ms. Nasrin deposits Tk. 2,50,000 into her retirement savings account on January 1 and another Tk. 2,50,000 on July 1 of the same year. The account earns 12% annual interest compounded semi-annually. Find the total interest earned at year end.

Solution:
Given,
Annual interest rate = 12%
Semi-annual interest rate (r) = (12% ÷ 2)
= 6%
= 6/100

For the 1st deposit on January 1,
Principal (P1) = Tk. 2,50,000
Time period (n1) = 2 half-years (1 full year)

Amount at year end for 1st deposit (A1) = P1 × (1 + r)n1
= 2,50,000 × (1 + 6/100)2
= 2,50,000 × (1.06)2
= 2,50,000 × 1.1236
= Tk. 2,80,900

Interest from 1st deposit (I1) = A1 - P1
= 2,80,900 - 2,50,000
= Tk. 30,900

For the 2nd deposit on July 1,
Principal (P2) = Tk. 2,50,000
Time period (n2) = 1 half-year (6 months)

Amount at year end for 2nd deposit (A2) = P2 × (1 + r)n2
= 2,50,000 × {1 + (6/100)}1
= 2,50,000 × 1.06
= Tk. 2,65,000

Interest from 2nd deposit (I2) = A2 - P2
= 2,65,000 - 2,50,000
= Tk. 15,000

ATQ, Total Interest = I1 + I2
⇒ Total Interest = 30,900 + 15,000
∴ Total Interest = 45,900

So, the total interest earned at year end = Tk. 45,900

questions.question: 78886. A ferry on the Padma River can travel 18 miles upstream and 28 miles downstream in 5 hours. In 7 hours, it can travel 24 miles upstream and 42 miles downstream. What is the speed of the river current in miles per hour?
questions.explain:
Question: A ferry on the Padma River can travel 18 miles upstream and 28 miles downstream in 5 hours. In 7 hours, it can travel 24 miles upstream and 42 miles downstream. What is the speed of the river current in miles per hour?

Solution:
Let, Speed of ferry upstream = u mph
Speed of ferry downstream = d mph

ATQ,
18/u + 28/d = 5 ... (i)
24/u + 42/d = 7 ... (ii)

Let,
1/u = x and 1/d = y
So, the equations become:
18x + 28y = 5 ... (iii)
24x + 42y = 7 ... (iv)

Multiplying equation (iii) by 4 and equation (iv) by 3:
⇒ 72x + 112y = 20
⇒ 72x + 126y = 21

Subtracting the first equation from the second equation:
⇒ 14y = 1
∴ y = 1/14

Putting the value of y in equation (iii):
⇒ 18x + {28 × (1/14)} = 5 
⇒ 18x + 2 = 5
⇒ 18x = 5 - 2
⇒ 18x = 3
⇒ x = 3/18
∴ x = 1/6

Since x = 1/u and y = 1/d:
⇒ Upstream speed (u) = 6 mph
⇒ Downstream speed (d) = 14 mph

Speed of current = (Downstream speed - Upstream speed)/2
= (14 - 6)/2
= 8/2
= 4 mph

So, the speed of the river current = 4 mph

questions.question: 78885. If 3<sup>(2x + 1)</sup> + 3<sup>(2x - 1)</sup> = 270, what is the value of (x + 2)<sup>(x - 1)</sup>?
questions.explain:
Question: If 3(2x + 1) + 3(2x - 1) = 270, what is the value of (x + 2)(x - 1)?

Solution:
Given that,
3(2x + 1) + 3(2x - 1) = 270
⇒ 32x × 31 + 32x × 3(- 1) = 270
⇒ 32x × {3 + (1/3)} = 270 
⇒ 32x × (10/3) = 270
⇒ 32x = (270 × 3)/10
⇒ 32x = 27 × 3
⇒ 32x = 81
⇒ 32x = 34
⇒ 2x = 4
∴ x = 2

Now,
(x + 2)(x - 1)
= (2 + 2)(2 - 1)
= 41
= 4

So, the value of (x + 2)(x - 1) = 4

questions.question: 78884. A rice trader in Naogaon marks up a sack of rice by 50% over its cost price. He offers a local grocer two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. If he still earns a profit of Tk. 200, what was the cost price of the sack of rice?
questions.explain:
Question: A rice trader in Naogaon marks up a sack of rice by 50% over its cost price. He offers a local grocer two successive discounts of 20% and 10%. If he still earns a profit of Tk. 200, what was the cost price of the sack of rice?

Solution:
Let, Cost Price (CP) = x
Marked Price (MP) = x + (50% of x)
= x + (x/2)
= 3x/2

Price after 1st discount of 20% = (3x/2) × {1 - (20/100)} 
= (3x/2) × (4/5)
= 6x/5

Price after 2nd discount of 10% = (6x/5) × {1 - (10/100)} 
= (6x/5) × (9/10)
= 27x/25

Profit = Selling Price - Cost Price
= (27x/25) - x
= 2x/25

ATQ,
⇒ 2x/25 = 200
⇒ 2x = (200 × 25)
⇒ 2x = 5000
⇒ x = 5000/2
∴ x = 2500

So, the cost price of the sack of rice = Tk. 2500

questions.question: 78883. A student guesses randomly on 4 true/false questions, so each guess is equally likely to be correct or incorrect. What is the probability that exactly 2 of the 4 guesses are correct?
questions.explain:
Question: A student guesses randomly on 4 true/false questions, so each guess is equally likely to be correct or incorrect. What is the probability that exactly 2 of the 4 guesses are correct?

Solution:
Let,
Total number of questions = 4
Possible outcomes for each question = 2 (Correct or Incorrect)
Total possible outcomes = 2 × 2 × 2 × 2 = 16

Number of favorable ways to get exactly 2 correct guesses out of 4 = 4C2
= (4 × 3)/(2 × 1)
= 6

ATQ,
Probability = Favorable outcomes/Total outcomes
⇒ Probability = 6/16
∴ Probability = 3/8

So, the probability that exactly 2 of the 4 guesses are correct = 3/8

questions.question: 78881. Which malocclusion classification category features a concave facial profile, a prominent chin, and a lower dental arch positioned forward relative to the upper arch?
questions.explain: Angle's Class III malocclusions present with a mesio-occlusion, often displaying a concave profile and prominent mandibular chin.

questions.question: 78880. The three main objectives of orthodontic treatment, known as Jackson's triad, include all EXCEPT:
questions.explain: Jackson's triad names the three pillars of orthodontic treatment as functional efficiency, structural balance, and esthetic harmony. Skeletal symmetry is not one of the named triad components, though it may be addressed as part of structural balance. The orthodontist strives to achieve all three of these objectives together rather than any one alone. This concept underlies why orthodontic planning always weighs function, structure, and appearance jointly.

questions.question: 78879. Preventive orthodontics is best described as:
questions.option1: Action taken to preserve the integrity of what appears to be normal occlusion
questions.option3: Undertaking technical procedures to correct existing malocclusion
questions.option4: Tongue pressure is always greater than lip and cheek pressure
questions.explain: Preventive orthodontics is defined as the action taken to preserve the integrity of what appears to be a normal occlusion at a specific point in time. It does not correct an existing problem but rather stops normal occlusion from developing into malocclusion in the first place. Option b describes interceptive orthodontics, option c describes corrective orthodontics, and option d describes surgical orthodontics. Distinguishing these four terms precisely is a frequently tested concept.

questions.question: 78878. Which of the following is NOT a listed drawback of Angle's classification of malocclusion?
questions.option1: It considers malocclusion only in the antero-posterior plane
questions.option2: It cannot be applied if the first permanent molars are missing
questions.option3: It differentiates clearly between skeletal and dental malocclusion
questions.option4: It cannot be applied to the deciduous dentition
questions.explain: Among Angle's classification's recognized drawbacks is that it does NOT differentiate between skeletal and dental malocclusion — this is a limitation, not a strength. The classification also only considers the antero-posterior plane, ignores transverse and vertical discrepancies, cannot be used when first molars are extracted or missing, and cannot be applied to deciduous dentition. Despite these drawbacks, it remains the most widely taught system due to its simplicity and ease of communication.

questions.question: 78877. Angle's Class II malocclusion is also known as:
questions.explain: Angle's Class II is termed disto-occlusion or post-normal occlusion, because the lower arch occludes at least half a cusp distal to normal relative to the upper arch. In this relationship, the disto-buccal cusp of the maxillary first molar occludes in the buccal groove of the mandibular first molar. This is the opposite of Class III, which is called mesio-occlusion or pre-normal occlusion. Recognizing these synonyms is important since exam questions often use the alternate terminology rather than "Class II" directly.

questions.question: 78876. Multiple supernumerary teeth are characteristically seen in all of the following EXCEPT:
questions.explain: Multiple supernumerary teeth are classically associated with cleidocranial dysplasia, Gardner syndrome, and oral-facial-digital syndrome type 1. Marfan's syndrome, in contrast, is instead listed among the syndromes associated with Class III malocclusion, not with multiple supernumerary teeth. Cleidocranial dysplasia in particular is notable for numerous unerupted supernumerary teeth alongside delayed exfoliation of deciduous teeth and clavicular abnormalities. Recognizing these syndrome associations helps orthodontists anticipate radiographic findings when treating syndromic patients.

questions.question: 78875. Which combination represents the most important interaction in the etiology of malocclusion?
questions.option3: Genetic predisposition modified by environmental influences
questions.explain: Malocclusion is generally multifactorial. Genetic factors establish the basic skeletal and dental pattern, while environmental factors such as habits, trauma, and premature tooth loss can modify the final occlusion.

questions.question: 78874. Andrews' Key 3 (crown inclination) states that:
questions.option1: Both maxillary and mandibular incisors show negative crown inclination
questions.option2: Maxillary incisors show positive inclination; mandibular incisors show mild negative inclination;
questions.option3: Maxillary incisors show negative inclination; mandibular incisors show mild positive inclination
questions.explain:
a) Incorrect. Maxillary incisors actually show positive crown inclination, not negative.
b) Correct. Key 3 states maxillary incisors have positive crown inclination, mandibular incisors show mild negative inclination, and both maxillary and mandibular posterior teeth show negative crown inclination.
c) Incorrect. Andrews specifically describes differing inclinations by tooth group, not a uniform zero value.
d) Incorrect. Canines are not singled out in Key 3; the key addresses incisors and posteriors broadly.

questions.question: 78873. The first step in managing a deleterious oral habit is generally to:

B: Correct. The etiologic habit should be identified and addressed.
C: Appliances may be required in selected persistent cases, but not automatically.
D: Surgery is inappropriate for a simple habit-related problem.

questions.question: 78871. What are the key dental characteristics of Angle's Class II Division 1 malocclusion?

questions.option3: Anterior crossbite and square facial profile and incompetent lips
questions.option4: Proclined maxillary central incisors, increased overjet
questions.explain: Class II Division 1 features proclined upper central incisors, an increased overjet, and typically incompetent lips.

questions.question: 78870. Excessive vertical overlap of the maxillary incisors over the mandibular incisors is called:
questions.explain:
A.Open bite represents inadequate or absent vertical overlap.
B: Correct. Deep bite is excessive vertical incisor overlap.
C: Reverse overjet is a horizontal/anterior-posterior discrepancy.
D: Crossbite generally refers to abnormal transverse or anterior tooth relationships.

questions.question: 78869. A child has a mesial step terminal plane. If forward mandibular growth continues excessively, the most likely future molar relationship is:
questions.explain:
A : A mesial step can produce Class I initially.
B :Distal step is more associated with Class II.
C ✅: Persistent differential forward growth of the mandible can convert the relationship to Angle Class III.
D : Division 2 is an incisor classification within Class II and does not describe this growth-related molar change.

questions.question: 78868. What is the typical shape of the dental arches in the deciduous dentition?
questions.explain: Deciduous dental arches are normally ovoid in shape, featuring a flush terminal plane, shallow inter-cuspal contacts, and minimal overjet.

questions.question: 78866. The curve that connects the buccal and lingual cusp tips of the mandibular buccal teeth, resulting from an inward inclination of the lower posterior teeth, is called the:
questions.explain: The Curve of Wilson is a medio-lateral curve connecting the buccal and lingual cusp tips of the mandibular posterior teeth, resulting from their inward (lingual) inclination. This curve serves two functional purposes: aligning teeth parallel to the direction of the medial pterygoid muscle for optimal resistance to masticatory forces, and elevating the buccal cusps to prevent food from escaping past the occlusal plane during chewing. The Curve of Monson is obtained by extending both the Curve of Spee and the Curve of Wilson to encompass all cusp tips and incisal edges, forming a single unifying reference sphere. The Curve of Spee, by contrast, runs in the antero-posterior direction rather than medio-laterally.

questions.question: 78865. Which sequence correctly matches the condition with its characteristic feature?
questions.option1: Class II Division 1 — retroclined maxillary central incisors
questions.option2: Class II Division 2 — increased overjet with proclined central incisors
questions.option4: Pseudo Class III — inability to move mandible backward
questions.explain:
A: Division 1 is associated with proclined or average maxillary incisors and increased overjet.
B: Division 2 is associated with retroclined maxillary central incisors and usually minimal/average overjet.
C: Correct. Class III has lower incisors anterior to the upper cingulum with reduced or reversed overjet.
D: In pseudo Class III, the patient can generally move the mandible backward toward edge-to-edge; inability to do so favors true Class III.

questions.question: 78864. Which approximate values of Leeway space?
questions.explain: Approximately 1.8 mm in the maxillary arch and 3.4 mm in the mandibular arch.

questions.question: 78863. Which is an INDICATION for serial extraction?
questions.option2: Class II or III malocclusion with skeletal abnormality
questions.explain:
a) Incorrect. Spaced dentition is a listed contraindication for serial extraction.
b) Incorrect. Class II/III malocclusions with skeletal abnormalities are contraindications, since serial extraction works best in Class I cases with harmonious skeletal/muscular systems.
c) Correct. Arch length deficiency (with crowding, irregular anteriors, physiologic spacing loss, etc.) is the most important indication for serial extraction.
d) Incorrect. Midline diastema is listed as a contraindication.
